paper.title: Structure and dynamics of electron-phonon coupled systems using neural quantum states
paper.authors: Ankit Mahajan, Paul J. Robinson, Joonho Lee, David R. Reichman

results.system_description: Spinless Holstein chain of 4 sites at half filling (2 fermions), omega0 = 1, g = 1.5, antiperiodic boundaries
results.method: Neural electron-phonon correlator on a Hartree-Fock reference
results.variant: MLP correlator (up to 10 N_sites hidden neurons), translationally symmetrized
results.source_location: Table tab:holstein_n (Sec. "Holstein model with finite filling"), row N_sites = 4, column "MLP (this work)"
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of a Hartree-Fock state multiplied by a complex MLP correlator of fermion and phonon occupations, optimized by VMC.
results.notes: Electron-phonon term g sum_i (c†_i c_i - 1/2)(b†_i + b_i) as written for this section; periodic boundaries for an odd number of fermions and antiperiodic otherwise (text). The phonon cutoff of the representation is not stated; a state in a truncated phonon space is a variational state of the untruncated Hamiltonian. For even chain lengths the sign of t is a gauge choice that preserves the boundary condition. The Jastrow, RBM and GFMC columns are quoted. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
